'''Project Chimera''' was a research team from the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] that attempted to investigate the corrupting effects that the [[Nightmare Lands]], a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], exerted on offworld wildlife. They successfully exposed non-native wildlife to the Nightmare Lands, but succumbed to the effects themselves; as the team's research was crucial to ongoing Imperial operations in hazardous environments on [[Aaris III]] and [[Sebiris]], the Science Bureau issued a bounty asking for the retrieval of the team's data.<ref name="PC" />
